summary: Arguments go over stdin because with pipelining they're never written to disk on the target, command-line args are visible to other users, and environment variables can be size-limited.
questions: Why does Ansible pass module arguments over stdin?
Are module arguments written to disk on the managed node?

answer_card.title: Why arguments go over stdin
answer_card.answer_md:
- With `ANSIBLE_PIPELINING`, args aren't saved to disk on the target, making secrets harder to steal.
- Command-line args are readable by unprivileged users.
- Environment variables can hit size limits and truncate parameters.
